facts.title: Watermelon White Sangria
ingredients: ½ medium nectarine, peach or plum, thinly sliced
½ cup raspberries, sliced strawberries or blackberries (optional)
1 to 2 tablespoons agave nectar or simple syrup (optional), to taste
facts.author: Cookie and Kate

steps.text: In a large pitcher, combine the prepared watermelon, nectarine, raspberries and lime. Pour in the St. Germain, followed by the entire bottle of sauvignon blanc. Gently stir with a big spoon to combine. Let the mixture chill in the refrigerator for 2 to 4 hours (the longer, the better).
Taste and stir in some agave nectar if the sangria isn’t quite sweet enough for you. Serve sangria in individual glasses, over ice.

notes: Recipe adapted from/inspired by Vibrant Food by Kimberley Hasselbrink.
facts.summary: The best white sangria recipe, featuring watermelon, summer fruit and St. Germain liqueur! This sangria is absolutely perfect for summertime sipping.
